run_magnet_gradio_app: run the MAGNeT Gradio UI for text-to-music generation with configurable model and decoding parameters
run_magnet_app_with_auth: run the MAGNeT Gradio app with username and password authentication on a custom port
load_model: load a pretrained MAGNeT model by version name such as facebook/magnet-small-10secs
do_predictions: generate audio from text prompts using the loaded MAGNeT model with temperature and top-p settings
predict_batched: batch predict audio outputs from multiple text descriptions using the magnet-small-10secs model
